headline: Blackhawks GM Kyle Davidson stands by Jeff Blashill, says he's actively seeking trades
take: Kyle Davidson isn't blinking. The Athletic reports the Blackhawks GM is standing by coach Jeff Blashill through a six-game losing streak and says he is actively looking for trades. The record is 4-13-1, nine points from 18 games, and our numbers say this isn't simply bad luck: Chicago has only 42% of the expected goals (the quality of chances), and allows 3.67 expected goals an hour. The goaltending has made it worse, letting in about 9.6 more goals than the shots deserved. That last part is the piece a coach can't fix and a trade might. Backing Blashill makes sense if Davidson believes the process will improve with better players; the numbers suggest the roster needs them, and the market for help is where he says he's looking.
